'''Entertainment Plaza''' was a district in [[Red Light Sector (Corellia)|Red Light Sector]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Blastfield Shipyards]]. The [[Rusty Freighter Cantina]] and the [[Gilded Descent Casino/Legends|Gilded Descent Casino]] were both located in the area.
